column2: Target becomes invisible until it moves or is damaged, lasts 60S.
Deals up to 16 damage per stack of corrupt on the target. Scales with karma, higher karma equals higher damage.
Deal up to 20 damage per stack over 5S. The higher the target's karma, the higher the damage.
30% of total health lost in the next 10S is re-dealt to the target.
Increases lifesteal, melee power and acceleration by 30% for 20S.
Darkens target's vision and reduces heal power by 20% for 5S.
Consume sleep to deal 20 damage and apply fear.
Consumes bleed to deal 20 damage over 5S.
Damage recieved in the next 10S is negated and target heals 20% missing health and becomes invisible for 10S.
Consume bleed to instantly deal 10 damage and apply weakness to the target.
Applies a 5% slow. While the target is moving, the slow is increased by 5% and target is dealt 3 damage, for 8S.
Consumes bleed to apply slow, deal 10 damage and reduce vision for 5S.
Increase acceleration, melee damage, range damage and reduces defence by 50% of target's max movement speed for 20S.
